title: Adjusting the mirror in a fitting booth
passage:
F: The late sun is hitting the fitting mirror. I can see the shoulders of this coat just fine, but the bottom almost disappears in the glare.
M: Angle the mirror a little to the left. Leave the stand where it is, though. People use the space in front of it to get to the next booth.
F: What if I close that blind? Wouldn’t that fix it?
M: It would, but then the counter would be too dark. Once the mirror looks right, put one piece of tape on each side of the hinge. The evening team can line them up if someone moves it again.
passageZh:
F: 傍晚的陽光照到試衣鏡。我看得清楚這件外套的肩部，但下襬幾乎被反光蓋住了。
M: 把鏡面稍微往左轉一點，但鏡架留在原位。大家要經過鏡子前方，才能走到下一間試衣間。
F: 要是我把那扇百葉窗關上呢？這樣不就能解決反光了嗎？
M: 是能解決，但櫃檯會太暗。把鏡面轉到合適的角度後，在轉軸兩側各貼一段膠帶。要是有人又移動鏡子，晚班同事就能把兩段膠帶對齊。
